epfl_amendment.label: POST-FAILURE CRITERION CHANGE, owner-approved: made after the H100 cross-hardware gate 1050341 failed only the two checkpoint energy / gradient bitwise rows; disclosed in every EPFL report

owner.authority: the owner, relayed by the main session
owner.context_verbatim: I told the owner that the EPFL gate's bitwise checkpoint rows will very likely fail on RTX as they did on H100. I offered two options: keep EPFL finals L40S-only, or put those two rows on RTX/H100 onto T01's tolerance while the state hash stays bitwise. The owner replied 「什么快什么来吧」.
options_verbatim: put those two rows on RTX/H100 onto T01's tolerance while the state hash stays bitwise

rule.recorded_per_row: the measured max abs and max relative difference, worst error over bound, the reference magnitude and the bitwise flag of the energy and of the gradient
rule.scope: the cross-hardware gate on RTX6000PRO and H100 only

t01_definition.applied: float32 (the gate's dtype): the energy and the geometry gradient each; the row passes iff both are allclose
t01_definition.code: scripts/v10/t01_validate.py reg_side_checks: rec.cmp(name, E2, torch.tensor(v0, float64), dn, bitwise=...) and rec.cmp(name, g2, g0, dn, bitwise=...); Recorder.cmp: PASS iff adapter.compare(x, y, dn)['allclose']
t01_definition.compare: src/v10/adapter.py compare(x, y, dtype_name): |x - y| <= atol + rtol |y| elementwise, y = the reference (the value before reload), both cast to float64, all finite

unchanged: every other row and part of the item-5 gate
L40S: completely unchanged; the item-5 gate 1048825 (bitwise rows) remains its gate

owner_capacity_authority.application: The remaining 6 K8/K32 units become three-partition jobs with recorded hardware and stratified reporting. This extension has no CAL tuning of its own: it inherits the K16 CAL selections, which were made on L40S and stay unchanged, so the "CAL 留 L40S" part needs no change here.
owner_capacity_authority.option_as_offered_verbatim: EPFL final、BF 和 EPFL 的 RuLSIF v2 final、K8/K32 剩下的 6 个单元，改为三分区，记录实际硬件、分层报告。CAL 和计时留在 L40S，保持每族 8 个 L40S GPU 小时的同等预算。先跑跨硬件门禁，再撤下未开始的作业重新提交。
owner_capacity_authority.standing_instruction_verbatim: 「后续待运行GPU任务统一 --partition=RTX6000PRO,L40S,H100，不要再按seed、方法或GPU型号人为分组/限卡；记录实际硬件与成本即可」
